name: avatar
description: Identity image, circular; initials/symbol fallback. Sizes via controlSize; needs label.
usage:
Avatar(Image("maya"), accessibilityLabel: Text("Maya Khalid"))

Avatar(initials: "MK", accessibilityLabel: Text("Maya Khalid"))
    .controlSize(.large)

Avatar(accessibilityLabel: Text("Unknown sender"))
accessibility: MUST supply label; none from face/monogram.
One image-trait element; ignores inner text/symbol.
Initials: tint/surface fill; scales with body text.
Diameter: controlSize, 24-72pt default; border: semantic token.
